title: sisymbrium irio var. maximum
intro: Sisymbrium irio var. maximum, commonly known as the Great Larkspur, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. The Great Larkspur has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues and skin conditions. Its therapeutic actions include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it a valuable remedy for treating bronchitis and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the Great Larkspur include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
